title: Rollcast: Proper-Score Gated Rolling Anchors for Adaptive Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.05561v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rollcast is a probabilistic forecasting method for univariate time series that combines a compact set of rolling statistical anchors rather than relying on a single global model. Rolling means, medians, extrema, regression endpoints, and quantiles define candidate forecast locations and a representation of the current state. A state-dependent softmax gate learns anchor probabilities by minimizing negative log predictive density, while residual distributions retrieved from similar historical states provide local uncertainty. Recursive simulation propagates the resulting mixture over multiple forecast horizons. The method is evaluated in a Monte Carlo study covering eight data-generating processes, including autoregressive, random-walk, local-trend, threshold, regime-switching, stochastic-volatility, heavy-tailed, and variance-break dynamics. translated_title: Rollcast：用于自适应概率时间序列预测的适当评分门控滚动锚点
translated_abstract: Rollcast 是一种针对单变量时间序列的概率预测方法，它结合了一组紧凑的滚动统计锚点，而非依赖单一的全局模型。滚动均值、中位数、极值、回归端点和分位数定义了候选预测位置以及当前状态的表示。一个状态依赖的 softmax 门控通过最小化负对数预测密度来学习锚点权重，同时从相似历史状态中检索的残差分布提供局部不确定性。递归模拟将所得混合分布传播到多个预测视界上。该方法在涵盖八种数据生成过程的蒙特卡洛研究中进行评估，包括自回归、随机游走、局部趋势、阈值、状态切换、随机波动、厚尾和方差突变等动态过程。在 2,000 个独立拟合序列上，Rollcast 与真实条件预测分布进行了比较（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: Rollcast 提出了一种用适当评分门控的滚动统计锚点集合替代单一全局模型的概率预测方法，通过状态依赖门控机制和相似历史状态的残差分布，在多种时间序列动态过程中实现自适应的不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: Rollcast replaces a single global model with a compact set of proper-score gated rolling statistical anchors, enabling adaptive probabilistic forecasting and local uncertainty quantification across diverse time-series dynamics.
